From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed on-site demo week of Jun 21 — agenda attached

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a full-day on-site demo and workshop at your HQ to walk through: deployment options, latency/cost tradeoffs, and an integration checklist.

Proposed window: week of Monday, June 21 — we can be flexible on day. Attached is a draft agenda and logistics checklist for the visit. Can you confirm whether that week looks good for your team (and who the attendee POC would be)?

If June 21–25 doesn't work we can either:
- shift to the following week (Jun 28–30) for a full-day, or
- run a hybrid: half-day onsite + follow-up async recording for others.

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.docx (draft), site-visit-logistics.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

— Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Cc: Fortiva Site Ops <siteops@fortiva.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed on-site demo week of Jun 21 — agenda attached

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the agenda — looks thorough. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Senior ops and one of the product leads are at a customer roadshow from Jun 20–24 and won't be available in person.
- Our engineering lead (Carlos) has pre-approved vacation Jun 22–25 and will be offline.

Given that, a full-day on-site during Jun 21–25 won't give us the right mix of stakeholders. Two options we'd prefer:
1) Move the on-site to the week of Jun 28 (Jun 28–30) so all stakeholders can attend in person, or
2) Keep Jun 22 as a shorter pilot on-site (core stakeholders only) and record the remaining sessions for the broader team.

If option 1 is workable for you, that would be ideal. Option 2 would only work if you can do a condensed half-day and provide the recording + a separate technical deep-dive with our eng team asynchronously.

Also, please keep the onsite logistics doc updated with parking/visitor policies — siteops will need that.

Best,
Jessica
Jessica Park
Director, Product Operations — Fortiva

Thanks for the heads up, Jessica — totally understand.

We can absolutely move the on-site to the week of Jun 28; I'll tentatively hold Jun 29 on our side while we lock attendees. If you prefer option 2 (condensed Jun 22), we can do a half-day focused on the deployment + live Q&A and deliver a recorded run-through of the remaining modules.

A couple of follow-ups from our side:
- Karthik, can you confirm internal coverage for a condensed half-day on Jun 22 if we go that route (I may need backup for the integration deep-dive)?
- Jessica, if Jun 28–30 is the target, which day is best for your execs? We'll prepare an updated agenda focused on stakeholder priorities.

I'll leave the logistics doc blank for siteops to annotate.

Thanks,
Maya
